instruction: A clean, minimalist lifestyle photograph captured from a low angle wide shot. Inside a bright, white-walled yoga studio with large windows and wooden wall bars, two subjects perform yoga. In the foreground right, the young woman in the beige sports bra (R4) is in a pigeon pose with both arms raised diagonally upwards and chest open. Behind her to the left, the blonde girl in the beige long-sleeve top (R5) mirrors the pose, raising both arms straight up. Both face forward with neutral expressions, aligned diagonally in unison. Bright, soft natural light fills the space, creating a serene, neutral-toned atmosphere.
